why: The count npm run conformance reports today. It is a ratchet, not a target: this number may fall and may not rise, per CLAUDE.md Session Discipline. It rose once, from 23 to 27 on 2026-09-13, by decision of the product owner: layout-manifests stopped exempting every dynamic route and began failing the four [id] pages no list–detail manifest names as its detailRoute (ADR-015 §5.3, amended). That was the check starting to see screens it could not, not a regression, and it is not a precedent. It fell back to 23 the same day, when /offers and /approvals became list–detail manifests and their [id] routes became their detail routes: four routes converted, not an exemption widened.

standing.layout-manifests: one per route whose page does not render through a layout manifest, including a dynamic route no list–detail manifest names as its detailRoute: /decision-flows/[id] and /decisions/[id] since 2026-09-13. /decision-flows/[id] waits for the Canvas + inspector renderer (ADR-015 §3), and /decisions/[id] for the Evidence reader's. The format and the list–detail renderer exist (ADR-015); the check reads each page.tsx, so a route clears only by being converted or, for a detail pane, by being named as its list–detail's detailRoute
standing.mock-banner: two screens read from fixtures without saying so. Three until 2026-09-13, when /settings began reading the tenant's locale and currency through the generated client (G-092)
standing.generated-client-only: api-client.ts is the hand-written transport the rule is about
standing.tokens-only: raw values that predate the token layer
